name: Google Docs Metadata
description: Reads the public metadata of link-shared Google Docs/Drive files: owner, email, timestamps and sharing role. Desktop only. A port of xeuledoc by Malfrats Industries (https://github.com/Malfrats/xeuledoc), licensed GPL-3.0.

plugins.name: Google Docs Metadata
plugins.description: Reads the public metadata of link-shared Google Docs/Drive files from selected URL nodes or from links/IDs entered in the Run dialog. Creates a URL node per document (title, MIME type, size, created/modified times, sharing role), linked "document metadata for" from the selected node, and an Account (Google account id, display name) with its Email Address for the owner and the last modifier, linked "owns document" / "last modified document" and "account email"; with create_person on, each Account also gets a Person linked "account". Up to 200 documents per run; folders, shortlinks and published (/d/e/) links are skipped. Desktop only.

url.title: Document URL or ID
url.description: Google Docs/Drive links or file IDs, separated by newlines or commas, read along with any selected URL nodes (up to 200 documents per run). Leave empty to use only the selection.

create_person.title: Create Person nodes
create_person.description: Links a Person named after the display name to each owner and last-modifier Account that has one; Persons with the same name merge into one node. Off by default.

web_probe.purpose: Look up each document's metadata on Google Drive.
